title: MCBA chief visits Norhazwani's family in Tumpat
summary: TUMPAT: The family of Malaysia Border Control and Protection Agency (MCBA) officer Norhazwani Ibrahim, who was found murdered in Nilai last month, received a visit from the agency’s director-general Datuk Seri Mohd Shuhaily Mohd Zain today.
